entries.title: Psalms 56:1
segments: To the Chief Musician. Concerning the silent dove-- those far off. Of David, a secret treasure--when the Philistines took him in Gath. Be merciful to me, O God, for man would swallow me up; fighting daily, he presses me down.

entries.title: Psalms 56:2
segments: My watchers panted for me daily; for many [are] they who proudly fight against me.

entries.title: Psalms 56:3
segments: When I am afraid I will trust in You.

entries.title: Psalms 56:4
segments: In God I will praise His word; in God I have put my trust; I will not fear what flesh can do to me.

entries.title: Psalms 56:5
segments: All day long they pervert my words; all their thoughts [are] against me for evil.

entries.title: Psalms 56:6
segments: They stir up strife; they hide themselves; they watch my steps as they wait for my soul.

entries.title: Psalms 56:7
segments: Shall they escape by iniquity? In anger cast down the peoples, O God.

entries.title: Psalms 56:8
segments: You number my wandering; O put my tears into Your bottle; [are they] not in Your Book?

entries.title: Psalms 56:9
segments: When I cry, then my enemies will be turned back. This I know, for God [is] with me.

entries.title: Psalms 56:10
segments: In God I will praise [His] word; in the LORD will I praise [His] word.

entries.title: Psalms 56:11
segments: In God I have put my trust; I will not be afraid of what man can do to me.

entries.title: Psalms 56:12
segments: Your vows [are] on me, O God; I will give praises to You.

entries.title: Psalms 56:13
segments: For You have delivered my soul from death; [have You] not [kept] my feet from falling, [so that] I may walk before God in the light of the living?
